rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Moon
rows.summary: Stress can pull you straight back into the comfort strategy you know by heart.
rows.body: Stress can pull you straight back into the comfort strategy you know by heart. When the Moon conjuncts the South Node, an old mood, family pattern, coping habit, or need for reassurance can feel unusually automatic. You may cancel the plan, call the same person, retreat into the same routine, or reach for the thing that has soothed you before. Comfort is not the problem. The question is what the habit costs when it becomes your only answer. Give yourself what actually helps now, not only what used to calm you down.

rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Neptune
rows.summary: Nostalgia can make an old pattern feel more beautiful than it was to live through.
rows.body: Nostalgia can make an old pattern feel more beautiful than it was to live through. Neptune conjunct the South Node can blur the line between meaningful memory and selective memory, especially around a person, dream, role, or chapter you once wanted badly. You may remember the promise and forget the daily cost. The feeling can still tell you something important about what mattered. Just do not use longing as evidence that the old arrangement should be restored exactly as it was.

rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Pluto
rows.summary: An old power struggle can return because some part of it still controls your choices.
rows.body: An old power struggle can return because some part of it still controls your choices. Pluto conjunct the South Node can bring a familiar obsession, authority dynamic, fear, or need for control back to the surface with unusual force. You may recognize the person, pattern, or feeling immediately, even if the circumstances are different. The repetition is useful because it shows where the past still has leverage. You do not have to win the old battle again to take that leverage back.

rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Saturn
rows.summary: An old responsibility may return because it was never fully released.
rows.body: An old responsibility may return because it was never fully released. Saturn conjunct the South Node can bring a former obligation, authority structure, debt of time, or role you have carried for years back into focus. You may be the obvious person to handle it because you already know the system and everyone trusts you to be responsible. That history matters, but it does not create an endless contract. Finish what is actually yours, renegotiate what has changed, and stop treating familiarity as proof that the burden still belongs to you.

rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Sun
rows.summary: An old version of you may be getting more attention than the one you are trying to become.
rows.body: An old version of you may be getting more attention than the one you are trying to become. When the Sun conjuncts the South Node, recognition can gather around a role, title, talent, or identity you already know how to carry. The praise may be deserved, and the opportunity may still be useful, but familiarity can make yesterday’s version of success feel more important than it is. Take what still belongs to you. You do not have to keep organizing your life around the part everyone already knows.

rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Uranus
rows.summary: A sudden break can release something you have been repeating for much longer than you realized.
rows.body: A sudden break can release something you have been repeating for much longer than you realized. Uranus conjunct the South Node can disrupt an old routine, role, alliance, or way of staying predictable because it once kept life manageable. The change may arrive faster than your explanation for it. Something that felt permanent can suddenly look optional. Do not rush to rebuild the exact arrangement just because the empty space feels strange. The disruption may be showing you how much of the pattern was habit.

rows.headline: South Node Conjunction Venus
rows.summary: An old attraction, spending habit, or way of earning affection can feel especially persuasive.
rows.body: An old attraction, spending habit, or way of earning affection can feel especially persuasive. Venus conjunct the South Node can bring a former relationship pattern, familiar pleasure, old client, or predictable money choice back into focus. The pull may be warm, flattering, and genuinely enjoyable because you already know how this story works. Familiarity does not make it bad. It does make it worth asking what you are repeating. Keep the pleasure or value that still holds up, and stop paying for it with a pattern you no longer want.

rows.headline: South Node Opposition Chiron
rows.summary: What is happening now may show you the difference between an old wound and a current need.
rows.body: What is happening now may show you the difference between an old wound and a current need. When Chiron opposes the South Node, a present vulnerability can stand directly across from the strategy you developed to protect yourself before. You may want to disappear, prove yourself, help everyone else, or avoid asking because that response once made sense. The old protection does not have to be mocked or discarded. It just needs to stop answering questions the present has not asked.

You may be tempted to measure the new option using an older definition of success. Keep the experience that taught you something. Let the definition change if your life has changed.

rows.headline: South Node Opposition Lilith
rows.summary: The current situation can put an old compliance pattern directly across from the part of you that refuses it.
rows.body: The current situation can put an old compliance pattern directly across from the part of you that refuses it. When Lilith opposes the South Node, you may feel pulled between playing the familiar role and rejecting it so completely that none of your existing skill can come with you. The past stays influential when every choice is either obedience or revolt. Keep what you learned. You do not have to keep the old terms in order to prove you are free of them.

rows.headline: South Node Opposition Mars
rows.summary: The action in front of you may force you to choose between an old reflex and a different result.
rows.body: The action in front of you may force you to choose between an old reflex and a different result. When Mars opposes the South Node, a deadline, conflict, boundary, or practical demand can make the familiar strategy impossible to ignore. You may know how to fight this fight, but that does not mean you have to. Use the strength the old experience gave you without reenacting the whole pattern. The goal is not to prove you can survive the same situation again.

rows.summary: A new piece of information can force an old story to defend itself.
rows.body: A new piece of information can force an old story to defend itself. When Mercury opposes the South Node, something you hear, read, or discuss may put a familiar belief or explanation directly across from the facts in front of you. You may feel the urge to return to the version you can explain most easily. Stay with the contradiction long enough to learn from it. You are allowed to know the history without letting the history write the answer.

It just does not get to define the only way you can care for yourself.

rows.summary: A current dream may expose how much an older fantasy still shapes what you expect.
rows.body: A current dream may expose how much an older fantasy still shapes what you expect. When Neptune opposes the South Node, the future you are imagining can come up against a story, longing, or ideal you have carried for a long time. The old picture may still be emotionally powerful even if it no longer fits the life in front of you. Name what you actually want now. You can honor the dream that got you here without making it the only acceptable ending.

rows.body: Responsibility can feel especially personal when carrying it becomes evidence of competence, authority, or worth. When the Sun conjoins Saturn, purpose and duty fuse, making deadlines, commitments, criticism, and added authority feel heavier because identity is wrapped into meeting the standard. The same pressure can support disciplined work without requiring exhaustion to become proof of character. The responsibility is clearer when the actual requirement is separated from the need to prove something through carrying it.

rows.headline: Sun Conjunction Uranus
rows.summary: A break from the old way can feel urgently necessary when the familiar role or routine no longer reflects what is changing.
rows.body: A break from the old way can feel urgently necessary when the familiar role or routine no longer reflects what is changing. When the Sun conjoins Uranus, purpose and disruption fuse, making experimentation, independence, and sudden changes of direction feel unusually important. A departure from routine can reveal something that has been outgrown without making shock value the same thing as freedom. The strongest change creates more room for the emerging direction without destroying every useful part of what came before it.

rows.headline: Sun Conjunction Venus
rows.summary: Being chosen, praised, or desired can make an offer feel more valuable before the offer itself has been fully judged.
rows.body: Being chosen, praised, or desired can make an offer feel more valuable before the offer itself has been fully judged. When the Sun conjoins Venus, attention, attraction, approval, and pleasure reinforce confidence, making another person's enthusiasm unusually influential. The compliment or invitation can be genuine without deciding what is actually wanted in return. Attention is easiest to use well once the pleasure of being picked is separated from the value of the thing being offered.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Chiron
rows.summary: Someone else's confidence can become especially irritating when it resembles a kind of visibility another person once learned to suppress.
rows.body: Someone else's confidence can become especially irritating when it resembles a kind of visibility another person once learned to suppress. When the Sun opposes Chiron, identity and sensitivity face each other directly, making another person's ease around recognition, leadership, or self-expression bring old comparison into the present. Irritation does not require admiration of the person displaying the trait. It can still reveal a form of permission that was distributed unevenly.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Jupiter
rows.summary: A larger opportunity can arrive with a workload that was easy to overlook while imagining everything the expansion would make possible.
rows.body: A larger opportunity can arrive with a workload that was easy to overlook while imagining everything the expansion would make possible. When the Sun opposes Jupiter, confidence and growth face each other directly, making the benefits of a bigger role, audience, goal, or commitment easy to see before the cost reaches the calendar, budget, or existing responsibilities. More can be better without fitting automatically. The opportunity becomes easier to judge once the life required to carry it is counted too.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Lilith
rows.summary: Being admired for one version of a role can put pressure on the parts that refuse to keep performing the same agreement.
rows.body: Being admired for one version of a role can put pressure on the parts that refuse to keep performing the same agreement. When the Sun opposes Lilith, recognition and autonomy face each other directly, making praise, status, visibility, or approval harder to enjoy when another person or group expects the rewarded version to remain unchanged. The conflict is not always between success and refusal. It can be about who gets to decide which parts of success are still worth keeping once the terms become visible.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Mars
rows.summary: Someone else's urgency can turn a routine disagreement into a contest over who gets the final say.
rows.body: Someone else's urgency can turn a routine disagreement into a contest over who gets the final say. When the Sun opposes Mars, purpose meets another source of action or pressure directly, making both sides more likely to defend authority instead of solving the problem. The conflict becomes easier to manage when the actual decision is kept separate from the adrenaline around it. Matching escalation rarely creates more leverage than returning to the concrete issue on the table.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Moon
rows.summary: An official decision can look necessary while the people living with it are absorbing costs the plan never put on paper.
rows.body: An official decision can look necessary while the people living with it are absorbing costs the plan never put on paper. When the Sun opposes the Moon, stated purpose and lived need face each other directly, making it harder for one version of the story to remain in charge. A budget or policy can explain why something changed without answering who loses pay, childcare, transportation, rest, or a workable routine because of it. The plan is more complete once its human cost is included in the same decision as its official rationale.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Neptune
rows.summary: Mixed signals can make it difficult to tell if a plan is genuinely promising or being completed by hope where the facts remain vague.
rows.body: Mixed signals can make it difficult to tell if a plan is genuinely promising or being completed by hope where the facts remain vague. When the Sun opposes Neptune, purpose and uncertainty face each other directly, making a person, promise, or opportunity look more convincing from a distance than it does after specific questions. A changing story or missing detail does not automatically invalidate the possibility. It does mean confidence needs enough evidence to know what is actually being agreed to.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Pluto
rows.summary: A disagreement changes once one side can freeze the deal, withhold access, or make a decision that materially narrows the other's options.
rows.body: A disagreement changes once one side can freeze the deal, withhold access, or make a decision that materially narrows the other's options. When the Sun opposes Pluto, purpose meets concentrated power, making pride and dependence easy to confuse with the original issue. Arguing harder does not make unequal leverage equal. The conflict becomes clearer when the remaining alternatives, outside sources of authority, and conditions that could reduce dependence are brought into view.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn
rows.summary: A delay, rejection, or hard limit can force a plan to show exactly what it can support under current conditions.
rows.body: A delay, rejection, or hard limit can force a plan to show exactly what it can support under current conditions. When the Sun opposes Saturn, purpose meets external resistance through deadlines, rules, responsibilities, or gatekeepers with authority to say no. A setback may require a smaller scope or longer timeline without invalidating the larger goal. The limit is most useful when treated as structural information rather than as a verdict on the worth of the whole direction.

rows.headline: Sun Opposition Uranus
rows.summary: Someone else changing the terms can expose how much of a plan depended on them remaining exactly as they were.
rows.body: Someone else changing the terms can expose how much of a plan depended on them remaining exactly as they were. When the Sun opposes Uranus, another person's decision to leave, change direction, ask for more freedom, or stop participating can force adjustment before the old structure is ready. Restoring familiarity may be impossible and may not be desirable. The break provides information about what is no longer available and what the next arrangement can no longer assume.

rows.headline: Sun Sextile Chiron
rows.summary: Visibility can become easier to tolerate when difficult history does not have to be erased before current ability is allowed to be recognized.
rows.body: Visibility can become easier to tolerate when difficult history does not have to be erased before current ability is allowed to be recognized. When the Sun sextiles Chiron, identity and sensitivity cooperate, allowing work, leadership, appearance, or experience to be seen without turning the older embarrassment or setback into the only story that matters. Recognition can include evidence of learning rather than requiring a flawless history. The present becomes easier to inhabit when the old mistake is no longer the price of every new exposure.

rows.headline: Sun Sextile Jupiter
rows.summary: A little more support can expand what is possible without requiring one good opening to become a complete reinvention.
rows.body: A little more support can expand what is possible without requiring one good opening to become a complete reinvention. When the Sun sextiles Jupiter, confidence and opportunity cooperate, helping money, visibility, encouragement, or access strengthen something that already has momentum. The opening does not need to become enormous to matter. Growth is most useful when the added room goes to the move that was already ready rather than creating pressure to enlarge everything at once.

rows.headline: Sun Sextile Mars
rows.summary: Momentum is easier to find when intention and action point in the same direction.
rows.body: Momentum is easier to find when intention and action point in the same direction. When the Sun sextiles Mars, initiative gets more support, making decisions, conversations, and plans easier to move from consideration into action. The ease is useful, but speed can start looking more convincing than the purpose behind it. Momentum is strongest when the reason is already clear and the remaining problem is execution rather than another round of planning.

rows.headline: Sun Sextile Moon
rows.summary: One small adjustment can make a demanding plan much easier to live with without changing the larger goal.
rows.body: One small adjustment can make a demanding plan much easier to live with without changing the larger goal. When the Sun sextiles the Moon, purpose and need cooperate, allowing a timeline, responsibility, or practical condition to shift enough that the whole arrangement becomes more workable. The conflict may not require abandoning the plan. It may require identifying the one part making ordinary life unnecessarily difficult.

rows.headline: Sun Square Moon
rows.summary: A plan can still look good on paper while ordinary life is starting to reject the way it is being carried out.
rows.body:
A plan can still make sense and be much harder to live with than you expected. When the Sun squares the Moon, what we are trying to accomplish can run up against what daily life actually requires. Exhaustion, responsibilities at home, or work that keeps falling to the same person become harder to treat as separate from the goal. 

You may not need to abandon the plan. You may need to change the way it is being carried. If the schedule only works when you are tired, irritated, or constantly compensating for what was left out, that strain belongs in the decision. A workable plan has to account for the life you are actually living, not the version of it that looked manageable on paper.

packageRecord.Headline: Sun Trine Jupiter
packageRecord.Summary: Support can gather around something that is already working without requiring the moment to become three new goals at once.

rows.headline: Sun Trine Lilith
rows.summary: We don’t have to defend a choice before anyone has even challenged it.
rows.body: When the Sun trines Lilith, it can be easier to let the parts of ourselves that do not fit neatly into other people’s expectations be seen without immediately turning them into a problem. The Sun is connected with visibility, purpose, and what we are willing to stand behind, while Lilith points to the places where we resist being shamed, managed, or made more acceptable for someone else’s comfort. A trine helps those two functions work together. Collectively, that can make it easier to speak more plainly about a boundary, stand behind a choice that is less conventional, or share something that feels less polished without rushing to explain why it deserves to exist.  The challenge is knowing the difference between actual pushback and the expectation of it. We can spend a surprising amount of energy preparing for judgment that has not happened yet, softening an opinion before anyone disagrees, or defending a decision before anyone has questioned it. This trine can make that reflex easier to notice. The point is to give ourselves enough room to see how people actually respond before deciding that we need to apologize, justify, or make ourselves easier to approve of.

When the Sun trines Mars, purpose and drive reinforce each other, reducing the drag between knowing what matters and doing something about it. The energy is especially useful for a move that requires nerve without requiring a crisis. Clear action feels different from manufactured urgency because the reason for moving already exists before the adrenaline does.

rows.summary: A decision becomes easier when the version that makes sense on paper also feels livable in ordinary life.
rows.body: A decision becomes easier when the version that makes sense on paper also feels livable in ordinary life. When the Sun trines the Moon, purpose and need reinforce each other, making it easier for forward movement to coexist with emotional and practical requirements. The right choice may feel less dramatic because it does not require constant internal negotiation to maintain. Compatibility between the goal and daily life is useful information in its own right.

rows.headline: Sun Trine Neptune
rows.summary: An idea that keeps returning can deserve a place in ordinary life instead of remaining something reserved for spare time and imagination.
rows.body: An idea that keeps returning can deserve a place in ordinary life instead of remaining something reserved for spare time and imagination. When the Sun trines Neptune, purpose and imagination reinforce each other, making creativity, compassion, and intuition easier to recognize as meaningful rather than merely impressive or escapist. Giving the idea a small, tangible form can reveal what it is capable of becoming. The point is not to make the dream grander, but to stop keeping something meaningful outside the life it is trying to enter.

rows.headline: Sun Trine Pluto
rows.summary: We can understand what a pattern is costing us and still keep making exceptions for it.
rows.body: With the Sun trine Pluto, we may feel ready to change what we’ve been trying so hard to tolerate. You might realize that being more organized won’t fix a situation that leaves you doing more than your share. The answer is not to squeeze more out of yourself, but to change what you’ve agreed to give. Use that confidence to renegotiate the work or tell someone what you can no longer take on. You can care about your commitments without making your own needs the first thing you sacrifice. Your strength can do more than help you get through the same situation again; it can help you change it.

Consistency can become evidence that more authority, trust, or responsibility is workable. The structure itself begins to confirm what enthusiasm alone could not prove.

rows.body: A change can feel more meaningful when it creates more authenticity rather than simply more excitement. When the Sun trines Uranus, purpose and experimentation reinforce each other, making a different routine, role, method, or identity easier to try without destroying everything familiar. The unfamiliar option may fit better because the people living inside the old structure have changed. The useful adjustment is the one that creates more freedom and still makes sense after the novelty passes.

rows.headline: Uranus Conjunction Chiron
rows.summary: A sudden change can touch an old vulnerability before anyone has had time to decide if the disruption is actually dangerous now.
rows.body: A sudden change can touch an old vulnerability before anyone has had time to decide if the disruption is actually dangerous now. When Uranus conjoins Chiron, change and sensitivity fuse, making a new technology, schedule, move, role, or break in routine resemble an earlier experience of being unprepared or exposed. The old reaction can arrive faster than the current evidence. The surprise becomes easier to use once what truly needs protection is separated from what merely feels familiar to the old wound.

rows.headline: Uranus Conjunction Lilith
rows.summary: A sudden break from expectation can bring a preference or refusal into the open before anyone has a plan for what comes next.
rows.body: A sudden break from expectation can bring a preference or refusal into the open before anyone has a plan for what comes next. When Uranus conjoins Lilith, disruption and autonomy move together, making an unconventional choice, abrupt exit, changed rule, or long-suppressed no harder to keep contained. There may be much less patience for preserving an arrangement simply because it is familiar. The break can create freedom and extra problems at the same time. The useful change is the one that removes the restriction that stopped fitting without destroying every support around it.

The break may be necessary without the replacement being freer by definition. Independence is easier to judge by who controls the terms after the transition, not only by what was escaped.

rows.headline: Uranus Opposition Chiron
rows.summary: Another person's sudden change can expose how much an old protection strategy depended on the surrounding world staying predictable.
rows.body: Another person's sudden change can expose how much an old protection strategy depended on the surrounding world staying predictable. When Uranus opposes Chiron, disruption and sensitivity face each other directly, making a cancellation, departure, changed system, or unexpected demand activate fears that were easier to manage under familiar conditions. If a sudden change is stirring up an older fear, you may notice that the support actually lost is smaller and more specific than every defense the surprise makes tempting to rebuild. The disruption can be inconvenient without recreating the original danger.

rows.summary: Someone else's refusal to keep following the old rules can expose how much the familiar arrangement depended on their continued cooperation.
rows.body: Someone else's refusal to keep following the old rules can expose how much the familiar arrangement depended on their continued cooperation. When Uranus opposes Lilith, disruption and autonomy face each other directly, making the old expectation harder to defend once one side stops agreeing to it. A broader frustration can surface around who was expected to adjust, wait, stay agreeable, or absorb the disruption so everyone else could keep the same arrangement. The change may feel sudden even when the dissatisfaction is not. The situation becomes easier to understand once the old expectation and the cost of maintaining it are named separately.

rows.headline: Uranus Square Lilith
rows.summary: The urge to break a rule gets stronger when the rule keeps blocking a choice that no longer feels optional.
rows.body: The urge to break a rule gets stronger when the rule keeps blocking a choice that no longer feels optional. When Uranus squares Lilith, disruption and refusal create friction, making compromise feel increasingly pointless when every compromise preserves the same restriction. What has been tolerated becomes harder to keep tolerating when nothing meaningful changes. If you feel the urge to reject the whole arrangement, it may help to separate the rule that no longer works from the support that still does. Change has more staying power when it removes the actual restriction instead of treating disruption itself as proof of freedom.

rows.headline: Jupiter enters Leo
rows.body:
We bring a creative pursuit into the open and invite friends to take part. What felt like a small pleasure can become the plan everyone wants to join before we know whether we can sustain it. As Jupiter enters Leo, we grow through visible self-expression, big-hearted generosity, and the confidence to risk a larger stage. Once praise starts coming, we commit more time, make bolder promises, and give the idea more room.

We feel the pressure when we begin judging the pursuit by the attention it receives. Jupiter expands whatever is already in motion, not only what deserves more room. Creative courage and inflated ego can grow together, until every setback threatens to become a drama. The desire does not need to shrink. The work is to keep sharing the thing without making the recognition the reason we stay. Once excitement settles into routine, we find out whether we are building a meaningful practice or only chasing applause.

rows.headline: Venus retrograde in Scorpio
rows.body:
An old relationship comes back around, and we feel the pull before we know whether anything has actually changed. We pause before answering and look at whether the old problem is different, not only whether the attraction has returned. Venus is retrograde in Scorpio, bringing love, loyalty, money, and private agreements back under review. The temptation is to treat the intensity as an answer, or to test the other person instead of asking them directly.

We return to the original arrangement and name what it has cost, what it has given, and which promises no longer fit. A commitment made years ago may still be worth keeping, but only if the bond gives something real now. Once those terms are spoken aloud, we can revise the commitment instead of forcing the old version to fit. What matters is whether we can keep the promise now, not how strong the pull is.

rows.headline: Chiron stations retrograde in Taurus
rows.body:
We set down a long personal project mid-build when the effort to make life secure starts costing more than it gives. As Chiron stations retrograde in Taurus, we pause the push to prove that we have enough, deserve enough, or can hold everything together through sheer consistency. This is not an alarm or a verdict on the project. It is a regular pause for repair inside a story already unfolding. When we talk at home about why the work stopped, an old fear may become plain: rest feels unsafe, comfort feels unearned, and every material choice becomes a measure of worth.

Instead of rushing back to the plan, we look at the survival response underneath it. Some of us stockpile to feel protected. Others refuse comfort entirely, to prove that no need can touch us. Living with this wound can make us unusually good at helping one another build stability without shame. The repair starts when being safe stops having to be earned.

rows.headline: Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces
rows.body:
A reply about a trip arrives far later than expected, the itinerary changes for a second time, and we begin filling the silence with guesses. Settling the matter quickly feels easier than sitting with the uncertainty, but we make better decisions by checking what was actually said and leaving room for revision. Mercury slows to a stop in Pisces and starts moving backward. In this sensitive water sign, we can catch tone, imagery, and feeling faster than facts, which makes intuition vivid and certainty less reliable.

When the same conversation circles back, the repeated wording may expose an assumption that kept us talking past one another. We can restate the agreement and confirm the times before anything gets booked. Not every plan falls apart here. Some decisions made during the pause hold. The useful change is knowing which part was an impression and which part was confirmed.

rows.headline: Calendar · Weekly Overview
rows.summary:
REUSABLE EDITORIAL TEMPLATE — CALENDAR / WEEK

Purpose: Prepare one collective Monday–Sunday forecast with an opening, connected daily entries, and a closing integration. This is a draft structure for owner review. It does not contain a finished horoscope or authorize publication. Keep this guidance in editor metadata; the Template pattern contains only named variables and the intended reader label.

INPUTS FOR EACH EDITION
Use the selected week, its local time zone, and verified calendar events. Retain exact event timestamps, event-time signs and degrees, motion, lunar phases, and source provenance in the edition’s fact record. Review the adjacent days only to establish relevant preparation or continuation. Do not import a previous year’s dates or interpretation as current facts. This collective Calendar template makes no personal house, rising-sign, natal-aspect, or Saturn-return assumptions.

VARIABLE DEFINITIONS
weekRange: The calculated Monday–Sunday date range, with year. State the edition’s time zone beside its timing information.
weeklyOverview: A complete opening that names the week’s central situation or tension, explains which developments make this week distinctive, and establishes how the beginning, major changes, and weekend relate. Give the most consequential events editorial weight. Establish the seasonal or longer-cycle context only where it explains this particular week. Do not retell every daily entry or force unrelated events into a single theme.
[monday–sunday]Date: The correct weekday and local calendar date for that entry.
[monday–sunday]Timing: A concise factual line of the events selected for that day, with verified local times and time-zone labels. Preserve chronological order. Include a Moon sign change when it changes the timing of the interpretation. An empty timing value is permitted when there is no relevant event to list; omit the empty line in a finished edition. These are supplied facts, not prose generated from memory.
[monday–sunday]Writeup: One complete authored daily entry following the guidance below. The seven variables are independent passages; they are not seven substitutions into a fixed sentence formula.
weeklyIntegration: A complete close that develops what the sequence of days has brought into focus and leaves the reader with a useful observation or next move. Do not repeat the opening, recap the entire event list, or introduce an unsupported forecast. Connect to the following week only when verified context warrants it.

DAILY ENTRY GUIDANCE
Choose each day’s actual editorial function from its events and context: opening, preparation, major development, follow-through, continuation, or transition. Do not assign those functions to fixed weekdays. Give a lunation, station, ingress, or consequential aspect priority when it shapes the day. On a day with several important events, explain how their meanings interact; do not simply concatenate standalone cards.

Translate the relevant astrology into a recognizable situation, show a consequence or complication, and let any practical advice follow from it. These are reasoning prompts, not mandatory sentence slots. Vary sentence length, paragraph development, and endings naturally. Use room in proportion to what needs explaining, without a fixed word-count target.

When the Moon remains in the same sign for consecutive days, the second entry should contribute a distinct observation supported by that day’s phase, aspects, or surrounding events. Do not fabricate a new development merely to create variety. Quiet days may emphasize ordinary continuity, enjoyment, curiosity, rest, or practical progress when the astrology supports it. Avoid assuming that every reader is exhausted, resentful, avoiding intimacy, or facing a crisis.

VOICE AND SOURCE USE
Use the current canonical TLDR writer and current applicable owner feedback when writing an edition. Retrieve complete relevant owner passages before drafting. The three [private] weekly articles supplied for this task are references for structure and voice: August 24–31, 2025; August 30–September 7, 2025; and September 7–14, 2025. Their historical event data must be independently verified. Preserve owner-authored passages in full; do not shorten or reconstruct them to fit this template.

Carry forward their strengths: an opening premise, continuity between days, recognizable behavior, specific consequences, purposeful humor, and an ending that develops the week’s meaning. A repeated permission line, “good for” list, seasonal lens, or polished maxim is not required. Avoid making every paragraph conclude with the same rhetorical movement. These are editorial review prompts, not automated judgments of voice.

CHECK THE COMPLETE EDITION
Confirm all seven dates and the chosen time zone; calculate daylight-saving labels for each event. Verify phase names, ingress and station dates, event-time placements, and any cycle references. Check timing within a day rather than treating the morning’s Moon sign as a full-day condition. Match every factual statement in the prose to the edition’s fact record.

Read the opening, all seven days, and the close together. Check that major events receive proportionate attention, consecutive entries add something, and the seasonal theme develops instead of being restated. Check daily wording for accidental “this week” scope. Show each exact event once and avoid repeating the same passage as both daily guidance and event detail. If an existing approved passage belongs in a detail destination, retain it intact there rather than compressing it into this template.

Resolve every required variable, remove empty optional timing lines, and keep these instructions, provenance, review notes, and internal day-role labels outside reader fields. A finished edition needs the owner’s review and exact-wording approval through the existing workflow.

STUDIO USE
Create a dated edition from this master and populate the named variables from verified facts and complete authored passages. This saved reference template defines the composition; automatic variable population and use in the public Calendar require their own source bindings and runtime integration. Saving this master does not change the live Calendar.

Based on the three user-supplied PDFs and the review of Calendar / Week for September 7–13, 2026. This template’s structure is proposed, not an assertion of owner approval for future prose.
